title: Commercial(e) Terrain
description:
Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?
 Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.
 Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.
 Votre rémunération
 Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :
 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible , à 100 % des objectifs
 Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
 Un variable entièrement déplafonné (à titre d'exemple, les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale)
 Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.
 Vos missions
 Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
 Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
 Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
 Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
 Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
 Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
 Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs
 Ce que nous vous proposons
 Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
 Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
 Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
 Un environnement…

title: Commercial Senior Manager, Expansion Markets
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

 

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

 

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role

We’re looking for a sharp, commercially-minded finance leader to own our Germany and AMEA Expansion Market's financial strategy and lay the foundations for European expansion.

You'll act as the central voice on performance, forecasting, and financial decision-making. From CAC and contribution margin to free cash flow and scenario planning, you’ll be responsible for turning financial insight into action.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional leaders across growth, operations, product, and care to shape the our Germany and AMEA Expansion Market's financial trajectory, while ensuring the business runs efficiently and invests wisely…

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Ping Identity:
 At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.
 Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.
 While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.
 We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.
 In this Software Engineer role, you will play an important part in the development of a market-leading, open standards first platform, providing flexible, modular and scalable identification, authentication, and authorization to a range of applications. You will be part of a team that prides itself on an open, flexible environment, embracing collaboration, agile methodologies, continuous improvement, and most of all, the love of a challenge.
 We require a passionate developer who flourishes in a fast-moving, agile environment. You must have good communications skills, an outstanding ability to translate requirements and designs to functional Java code, and a strong attention to security, quality, testability and performance.
